# technitium_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists records in a zone, optionally filtered by name and type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "technitium_dns_records" "mx" {
  zone = "example.com"
  type = "MX"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Zone name.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only records with this zone-relative name (`@` for the apex).
- `type` (String) Only records of this type, e.g. `A`.

### Read-Only

- `records` (List of Object) Records: `name` (zone-relative), `fqdn`, `type`, `ttl`, `disabled`, `comments` and `data` (the record's fields as strings, e.g. `ipAddress`, `exchange`; structured values JSON-encoded). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `data` (Map of String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `fqdn` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `ttl` (Number)
- `type` (String)
